name: onchain-desk-brief
description: Cited on-chain desk brief for one EVM wallet or one protocol — Alchemy token-by-address (x402 via Circle Gateway), Allium token search + latest price (MPP on Tempo), SELAT-native Twitter chatter (x402 via Circle Gateway). Paid per call via selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway).

address.description: EVM wallet or protocol-token/contract address for the Alchemy token-by-address step (used as ${address}). Always pass the user's 0x address explicitly when they gave a wallet.

protocol.description: Protocol or token name for Allium token search (used as ${protocol}). Retarget alongside address and twitter_query.

tokenChain.description: Lowercase Allium chain name for token search and latest price (used as ${tokenChain}). EVM only — do not pass solana.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address for the Allium latest-price step (used as ${tokenAddress}). Native ETH is the zero address.

twitter_query.description: SELAT-native Twitter advanced-search query (used as ${twitter_query}). Widen with protocol, token ticker, or a known wallet label — not a raw 0x dump.

steps.label: twitter chatter — SELAT-native advanced search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
on-chain token footprint — Alchemy token-by-address (x402 via Circle Gateway)
token identity — Allium tokens search (MPP on Tempo)
latest token price — Allium prices (MPP on Tempo)
